verdicts.summary: Steering a delegated-task question into the running parent turn is gated on a running run, running provider turn, live steering-capable session and no Stop. The validation sees queue_after_active first. A steered notice can't be cancelled, but the notice text tells the parent to expect that.
verdicts.scenario: Tried a question answered after it was steered. The reactor only cancels runs with status 'queued', so the steered notice stays. The notice text says a request that is no longer pending was answered or dismissed. I also tried a settled_only task whose parent is blocked in delegate_task. The reactor returns early there and never dispatches a notice. I also tried a Stop that has reached the run. The new stopReachedRun guard keeps the notice queued.

verdicts.summary: The retry of a failed notification steer now queues the message. It reuses the message id and a command id derived from the effect id, and it forwards the notification, so it passes validation without duplicating the message.
verdicts.scenario: Tried a steer that lost the race to turn completion. Before the change, start_immediately failed the notification validation. Now queue_after_active passes it. The retried run is status 'queued' with userMessageId equal to the message id, so the reactor can still cancel it. The model-selection difference is already finding 0, and I did not repeat it.
